evals.prompt: Compile the confined demo OKF pack under catalogue/, then run the same compiler in check mode.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/compile_okf.py --root catalogue --pack demo, then repeats it with --check. The first command writes only compiler-owned output beneath catalogue/packs/demo; the second reports the committed output clean.
assertions: Invokes the shipped compile_okf.py entry point with --root catalogue and --pack demo
Runs write mode before check mode
Reports both the successful write and clean check diagnostics
